mentions.name: Swirl Together
mentions.description: An art therapy sandbox built on Pavel Dobryakov's fluid simulation. It is nearly finished, planned for release on Steam and later as fully open source on GitHub, with a free playable browser version available at the project's site. The author has used it personally over the years and finds it soothing.
mentions.audience: Hopefully others can find it soothing and beneficial, just as I have.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building an art therapy sandbox upon Pavel Dobryakov's fluid sim, and I'm almost finished, and going to release on Steam, and shortly after, I'll be releasing it on GitHub fully open source.
mentions.author: Gabriel_Martin
